title: Post-baseline trajectory attrition can manufacture early-state predictivity
result: A complete-case longitudinal analysis can create either positive or negative early-state/late-output association from a full set with zero covariance when retention depends on post-baseline trajectory characteristics.
HF01_implication: donor-held-out validation does not by itself protect against selective follicle attrition
culture failure, loss of trackable identity, imaging failure, early catagen/death and technical exclusion can be biologically informative rather than ignorable missingness
post-treatment survival/retention must not silently become an analysis inclusion criterion
required_controls_for_HF_VAL_006: account for every enrolled/eligible follicle from baseline to analysis disposition
freeze exclusion rules before late outcomes are inspected
report attrition by donor, region and intervention arm
treat biological death/catagen/failure as an outcome where scientifically appropriate rather than automatically deleting it
perform sensitivity analyses when late output is unobserved and missing-not-at-random cannot be excluded
claim_boundary: This synthetic construction demonstrates possibility of bias; it does not quantify expected attrition bias in any particular organ-culture experiment.
